set -euo pipefail
D=/data/tk0303/thr
mkdir -p "$D"
cd "$D"
python3 "$(dirname "$0")/btc-lag-thresholds.py" --btc-seconds /data/tk204/btc-seconds --all-q --out btc-lag-thresholds-allq.json &
P1=$!
refs=()
for m in jan feb mar apr may jun jul aug sep oct; do refs+=(--ref "/data/tk046/$m/home/alpha/epochs/e-$m/study/regime/ref-BTCUSDT-1m.csv"); done

wait $P1
echo ok > thr.rc
EOF
chmod +x tools/compute/tk303-thr.sh; bash -n tools/compute/tk303-thr.sh && echo syn-ok; git checkout docs/registry/plan_cells.jsonl 2>&1 | tail -1; git add tools/analyze tools/compute/tk303-thr.sh && git commit -q -m "[Инженер] TK-303: пороги F2 — все целые q 1..99, лаги 78/91/104 (btc-lag-thresholds, btc-thresholds --all-q), скрипт задания

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>" && git log --oneline -1; date

p="tools/registry/master.py"

crlf = "\r\n" in s
print("crlf",crlf)

assert s.count(a)==1

b='_int_in(_frac(av["btc_lag_s"]), (1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32, 64, 118)) if fam == "g72" else None'
assert s.count(b)==1
s=s.replace(b,'_int_in(_frac(av["btc_lag_s"]), (1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32, 64, 78, 91, 104, 118)) if fam == "g72" else None')
c='''            LINES[h] = (None, f"{hyp}: q ∈ {{5,10,20,33,50,67,80,90,95}}" + (", лаг ∈ {1,2,4,8,16,32,64,118} с" if fam == "g72" else ""))
        elif not thr:
            LINES[h] = (None, f"{hyp}: нет {os.path.basename(_P15_THR)} (tools/registry/p15_scope.py --write-research)")
        else:'''
assert s.count(c)==1
s=s.replace(c,'''            LINES[h] = (None, f"{hyp}: q — целое 1..99" + (", лаг ∈ {1,2,4,8,16,32,64,78,91,104,118} с" if fam == "g72" else ""))
        elif not thr:
            LINES[h] = (None, f"{hyp}: нет {os.path.basename(_P15_THR)} (tools/registry/p15_scope.py --write-research)")
        elif q not in thr:
            LINES[h] = (None, f"{hyp}: нет порогов q={q} в {os.path.basename(_P15_THR)} (btc-lag-thresholds.py/btc-thresholds.py --all-q, p15_scope.py --write-research)")
        else:''')
open(p,"w",encoding="utf-8",newline="").write(s)
